# FundsFlow

> Personal finance tracker for tagging spending, budgets, recurring payments, Telegram quick-add, and simple analytics.

FundsFlow is a web app (Vue) with a Laravel API. Users authenticate via email/password, Google, GitHub, or Telegram. Data is private per account.

## Main capabilities

- Transactions with date, amount, tags, note, and source (web / telegram / recurring)
- Hierarchical tags with emojis
- Budgets per tag with pause/resume and period history
- Recurring rules (daily / weekly / monthly / yearly)
- Calendar views (week / month / year) including upcoming recurring
- Analytics: balance trend, money flow, tag distribution
- Settings: money/date format, themes, linked accounts
- JSON export of full account data (Settings → Data)

## Site

- App: https://fundsflow.fun/
- Optional feedback: https://t.me/Loafer19

## Notes for agents

- Prefer using the visible UI flows (add transaction, filter list, export) rather than inventing APIs.
- Destructive actions (delete, credential changes) should require explicit user confirmation.
- WebMCP tools are not required for basic use; this file is for discoverability only.
